title: 第1章  开局大婚，娶妻生子都有奖励！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
大红喜烛“噼啪”炸开一星烛火。
赵辰安猛地惊醒，眼前是一片刺目的红。
身前，一道身影端坐不动，头顶的红盖头遮住了一切。
只留下一双交叠在膝前、因紧张而绞紧的素白小手。
他的新娘？
这是……婚房？！
“唔！”
一股不属于他的记忆进入脑海！
无数画面直接炸开！
【大周王朝，十六皇子，赵辰安！】
【天生凡体，苦海闭塞，此生与仙道无缘！】
【皇室废人！】
【父皇愧疚，兄姐疼爱，皇城第一纨绔！】
记忆如潮水般涌来，最终定格在今夜这场荒唐的大婚上。
大周王朝铁蹄踏破天狼部落，为表臣服，部落献上他们最神圣的圣女——乌兰雪。
那些高高在上的皇兄们，谁会要一个战败小族的女人？
于是，这份“荣耀”理所当然地落到了他这个皇室第一废柴的头上。
用最没用的皇子，娶你们最神圣的圣女。
这是何等的羞辱！
怎么，不服？

不服正好，那就再打一场，这次直接灭了你们区区部落！
说白了，这也是周国对天狼部落的一种服从性测试。
他抬起头，目光死死盯着眼前那道安静得如同木雕的身影。
红盖头之下，会是怎样一张脸？
是绝望哭泣，还是恨不得将他生吞活剥？
一股狂躁的好奇心压倒了一切。
他想看看她！
赵辰安猛地伸出手，一把攥住那方红盖头的边角，毫不温柔地向上掀开！
红绸滑落。
刹那间，赵辰安的呼吸被扼住了。
烛光摇曳，映照着一张纯净到极致的脸。
肌肤胜雪，五官仿佛神明最完美的造物，糅合了江南的秀美与草原的英气。
不是漂亮，是圣洁。
圣洁到让人感觉任何一丝杂念都是对她的亵渎。
随着他的动作，她惊惶地抬起头。
那是一双何等清澈的眸子，倒映着烛火，也倒映着他。
眸中有惊慌，有倔强，还有一丝被毁灭家园后的深切悲伤。
乌兰雪。
天狼部落的圣女，他的妻子。
身为一个阅片无数的现代人，赵辰安自认见惯了顶级颜值。

可眼前这张脸，却带着一种直击灵魂的真实与惊艳。
一个最原始的念头，如疯长的野草瞬间占据了他的全部心神！
——她是我的！
他身体不受控制地前倾，手掌带着灼人的热度，朝着她那吹弹可破的脸颊抚去。
就在指尖即将触碰到那温润肌肤的瞬间——
一行冰冷的金色文字，毫无征兆地在他视野正中央炸开！
【叮！万嗣天骄系统启动……绑定成功！】
【宿主：大周王朝十六皇子，赵辰安！】
赵辰安的动作骤然僵住，手掌悬停在半空，距离乌兰雪的脸颊不过半寸。
系统？！
穿越者的金手指？！
一股狂喜如火山爆发，瞬间冲垮了理智！
我的外挂到账了！
视野中的金色文字疯狂刷新！
【检测到宿主正妻：天狼部落圣女，乌兰雪。】
【核心功能激活：根据妻子资质评分，宿主可获得十倍暴击奖励！】
【若得到子嗣，将会根据评分，获得百倍暴击奖励！】
【开始对乌兰雪进行综合资质评分……】
【容貌：99（倾国倾城，神颜绝世）】
【资质：30（中人之姿，泯然众人）】

【特殊血脉：天狼血脉（初级，潜力巨大）】
【特殊性格：纯洁忠贞（极品）】
【综合评分判定中……】
【最终综合评分：81分（优良）！】
赵辰安的心脏砰砰狂跳！
八十一分！十倍暴击奖励！
会是什么？
还是能让我这个废柴直接逆天改命的无上体质？！
【优良级评分已触发十倍暴击奖励！】
【奖励正在发放……】
【恭喜宿主！获得天品功法：《大道天衍经》！】
看到奖励的瞬间，赵辰安脑子一片空白。
还是天品功法？！
他脸上的狂喜瞬间凝固，然后一寸寸垮掉，最后只剩下无尽的错愕与荒谬。
系统……你是不是搞错了？
我，赵辰安，天生凡体，苦海闭塞，不能修炼！
你给我一本天品功法？！
这算什么？
给一个双腿残废的人一双绝世神靴？
给一个瞎子一幅传世名画？

这是奖励？
这他妈是二次羞辱！
赵辰安几乎要气炸了！
就在这时，一道怯生生的、带着微颤的声音响起。
“你……你就是我未来的夫君吗？”
乌兰雪看着眼前这个脸色变幻不定的男人。
鼓起了全部勇气，轻声问道。
她的声音像山涧的清泉，带着一丝清冷，却又无比动人。
赵辰安猛地回神，目光从脑海中那本金光闪闪的《大道天衍经》，重新落回到眼前这张绝美的脸上。
看着她眼中的惊慌与无助，他心头的怒火莫名被浇熄了几分。
系统不靠谱，功法是废纸，但眼前这个活色生香的绝色美人，可是货真价实的。
什么狗屁羞辱，什么天品功法……
春宵一刻值千金！
他深吸一口气，压下所有杂念，嘴角勾起一抹纨绔皇子该有的邪魅笑容，再次朝她探出手去。
“没错，从今晚起，我就是你的男人。”
（省略内容加入书架后即可展开！）
次日清晨。
天光微亮，透过窗棂洒下斑驳的光影。
赵辰安睁开眼，身侧是温热的触感。
乌兰雪还在沉睡，长长的睫毛在白皙的肌肤上投下一片小小的阴影，呼吸平稳而绵长。

昨夜的疯狂褪去，只剩下被褥间淡淡的馨香和她酣睡的模样。
她蜷缩着，像一只毫无防备的小兽，与昨夜那带着野性的姿态判若两人。
赵辰安撑起半个身子，静静地看着她。
这张脸，真是百看不厌。
可惜，资质只有30分。
不过，血脉潜力巨大，性格极品……综合评分81，已经算是不错的开局了。
一个念头在他脑海中盘旋。
如果换一个容貌99，资质99，血脉、性格全是顶级的女子，那奖励会是什么？
仙品功法？
还是传说中的无上圣体？！
一想到那种可能，赵辰安的心脏就抑制不住地狂跳起来。
当然，就算娶不到那种天骄，只要眼前这位容貌绝色的妻子给他生一个子嗣！
百倍奖励，依旧让赵辰安无比心动。
想到这里，他的手不受控制地滑向了身边的温软。
乌兰雪在睡梦中轻哼了一声，下意识地朝他怀里蹭了蹭。
这一下，直接触发了赵辰安的保底机制！
开盖有奖，再来一次！
content_en:
The big red wedding candle "crackled" and exploded into a star of candlelight.
Zhao Chenan woke up suddenly, his eyes were filled with blinding red.
In front of him, a figure sat motionless, with a red hijab covering everything.
All that was left was a pair of small white hands folded in front of his knees, clenched with nervousness.
His bride?
This is...the wedding room? !
"Ugh!"
A memory that does not belong to him enters his mind!
Countless pictures exploded directly!
[Great Zhou Dynasty, sixteenth prince, Zhao Chenan! 】
[Born with a mortal body, the sea of suffering is blocked, and there is no chance of immortality in this life! 】
【Royal waste! 】
[Father is guilty, brothers and sisters love him, and he is the most handsome man in the imperial city! 】
Memories came flooding in, finally settling on this ridiculous wedding tonight.
The Zhou Dynasty crushed the Tianlang tribe with its iron hoof, and in order to show its surrender, the tribe presented their most sacred saint, Wu Lanxue.
Among those high-ranking royal brothers, who would want a woman who defeated a small clan?
Therefore, this "honor" naturally fell on him, the best loser in the royal family.
Use the most useless prince to marry your most sacred saint.
What a shame!
What, you don’t accept it?
If you don't accept it, let's fight again, and this time we will directly destroy your tribe!
To put it bluntly, this is also a kind of obedience test for the Tianlang tribe by Zhou State.
He raised his head and stared at the figure in front of him that was as quiet as a wooden sculpture.
What kind of face does it look like under the red hijab?
Weeping in despair, or wishing to eat him alive?
A manic curiosity overcame everything else.
He wants to see her!
Zhao Chenan suddenly stretched out his hand, grabbed the corners of the red hijab, and lifted it up without any gentleness!
The red silk slipped.
In an instant, Zhao Chenan's breath was choked.
The candlelight flickered, reflecting an extremely pure face.
Her skin is better than snow, and her facial features are like the most perfect creation of the gods, blending the beauty of the south of the Yangtze River with the heroism of the grassland.
Not beautiful, but holy.
So holy that it makes people feel that any distracting thoughts are blasphemous to her.
Following his movement, she raised her head in panic.
What a pair of clear eyes they were, reflecting the candlelight and him.
There was panic, stubbornness, and a trace of deep sadness after his home was destroyed in his eyes.
Wu Lanxue.
The saint of the Sirius tribe, his wife.
As a modern person who has read countless films, Zhao Chenan considers himself accustomed to seeing top-notch looks.
But the face in front of him carries a kind of reality and amazement that directly touches the soul.
The most primitive thought, like a wildly growing weed, instantly occupied his entire mind!
——She is mine!
He leaned forward uncontrollably, his palms filled with scorching heat, caressing her cheeks that could be broken by blows.
Just when the fingertips were about to touch the warm skin——
A line of cold golden text exploded in the center of his field of vision without any warning!
【bite! Wan Si Tianjiao system started...binding successful! 】
[Host: The sixteenth prince of the Zhou Dynasty, Zhao Chenan! 】
Zhao Chenan's movements suddenly froze, and his palm hovered in mid-air, less than half an inch away from Wu Lanxue's cheek.
system? !
The golden finger of the time traveler? !
A wave of ecstasy erupted like a volcano, instantly overpowering reason!
My plug-in has arrived!
The golden text in the field of vision refreshes crazily!
[The host’s wife is detected: the saint of the Sirius tribe, Wu Lanxue. 】
[Core function activation: Based on the wife’s qualification score, the host can receive ten times the critical hit reward! 】
[If you get an heir, you will get a hundred times the critical hit reward based on the score! 】
[Start comprehensive qualification scoring of Wu Lanxue...]
[Appearance: 99 (overwhelming country and city, peerless beauty)]
[Qualification: 30 (the appearance of a middle-aged man, disappearing into the crowd)]
[Special bloodline: Sirius bloodline (elementary, huge potential)]
[Special Character: Purity and Loyalty (Excellent)]
[Comprehensive score is being determined...]
[Final overall score: 81 point (excellent)! 】
Zhao Chenan's heart was beating wildly!
Eighty-one points! Ten times the critical hit reward!
What will it be?
Or is it a supreme physique that allows me, a loser, to change my destiny directly? !
[Excellent rating has triggered ten times the critical hit reward! 】
[Rewards are being distributed...]
[Congratulations to the host! Obtain the heavenly skill: "Dao Tian Yan Jing"! 】
The moment he saw the reward, Zhao Chenan's mind went blank.
Or is it a Tianpin technique? !
The ecstasy on his face froze for an instant, and then collapsed inch by inch, leaving only endless confusion and absurdity.
System...did you make a mistake?
I, Zhao Chenan, was born with a mortal body, blocked by the sea of ​​suffering, and unable to practice!
Will you give me a copy of Tianpin Kung Fu? !
What is this?
Give a man with crippled legs a pair of peerless boots?
Give a blind man a famous painting?
Is this a reward?
This is a second fucking humiliation!
Zhao Chenan almost exploded with anger!
At this moment, a timid, slightly trembling voice sounded.
"You...are you my future husband?"
Wu Lanxue looked at the man with an ever-changing expression in front of her.
He summoned up all his courage and asked softly.
Her voice is like the clear spring of a mountain stream, with a hint of coldness, but extremely moving.
Zhao Chenan suddenly came back to his senses, and his eyes returned from the glittering "Dao Tianyan Sutra" in his mind to the beautiful face in front of him.
Seeing the panic and helplessness in her eyes, the anger in his heart was inexplicably extinguished.
The system was unreliable and the techniques were useless, but the lively and stunning beauty in front of her was the real deal.
What bullshit humiliation, what kind of heavenly skills...
A moment of spring night is worth a thousand pieces of gold!
He took a deep breath, suppressed all distracting thoughts, raised an evil smile on his lips like a playboy prince, and stretched out his hand towards her again.
"Yes, from tonight, I am your man."
(Omit the content and add it to the bookshelf to expand it!)
Early next morning.
The sky was slightly bright, casting mottled light and shadow through the window lattice.
Zhao Chenan opened his eyes and felt a warm touch on his side.
Wu Lanxue was still sleeping, her long eyelashes casting a small shadow on her fair skin, and her breathing was steady and long.
The madness of last night faded away, leaving only the faint fragrance between the sheets and the look of her sleeping soundly.
She curled up like a defenseless little animal, completely different from her wild posture last night.
Zhao Chenan propped up half of his body and looked at her quietly.
This face is something I never tire of seeing.
Unfortunately, the qualification is only 30 points.
However, his bloodline has great potential and his character is excellent... The overall score is 81, which is already a good start.
An idea swirled in his mind.
If we change to a woman with 99% appearance, 99% qualifications, top-notch bloodline and top-notch personality, what will be the reward?
Immortal skills?
Or the legendary Supreme Holy Body? !
When he thought of that possibility, Zhao Chenan's heart couldn't help but beat wildly.
Of course, even if he can't marry that kind of genius, he only needs this stunningly beautiful wife in front of him to give him an heir!
The hundredfold reward still made Zhao Chenan extremely excited.
Thinking of this, his hand slid uncontrollably to the warmth beside him.
Wu Lanxue snorted softly in her sleep and subconsciously nuzzled into his arms.
This time, Zhao Chenan's guarantee mechanism was directly triggered!
Open the lid and win a prize, come again!
